name: Multiple Importance Sampling for Boundary Paths
definition: Zhang et al. (2020) decompose the boundary integral into direct and indirect terms using next-event estimation. The direct term accounts for boundary paths where vertex xS0 is on a light source.
summary: Multiple Importance Sampling for Boundary Paths combines unidirectional and bidirectional volume boundary estimators using path-level MIS to reduce variance in differentiable volume rendering.
